feedback.workpiece.barrel_unmeasured: A bored barrel. Calipers would say how wide.
technique.feedback.punch_projectiles: Punches any projectile back at 2.5x speed
modular.feedback.desc.part.vial_body: A small hollow body, cut from crystal or pressed from paper. Made as a vial, a flask of three cells or a carboy of nine, it holds experience: a bigger one holds more, and the material sets the level it can stand at and how much a cell takes. A material that cannot hold experience makes a vial that holds none.
modular.feedback.role.vial.tip: The vessel itself. Its material sets the level it can stand at and how many points a cell of it holds; its size sets how many cells.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.flask: Like a vial body, but three cells of stock: holds three times as much.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.carboy: Like a vial body, but nine cells of stock: holds nine times as much.
item.feedback.gear.joint: Weapon joint rating: +%s of the blow shared
hazard.feedback.tongs_cold: Not hot enough to need them
tooltip.feedback.modular.perk.echo: Echo (struck targets are outlined and heard by sculk)
tooltip.feedback.modular.perk.blink: Blink %s (a kill steps you into its place)
modular.feedback.role.head: head
modular.feedback.desc.part.pickaxe_head: The business end of a pick: a pointed head for breaking stone and ore.
modular.feedback.desc.part.axe_head: A wedge of metal that bites into wood. A fair weapon too.
modular.feedback.desc.part.shovel_head: A broad scoop for digging earth, sand and gravel.
modular.feedback.desc.part.hoe_head: A narrow blade for tilling soil and clearing crops and leaves.
modular.feedback.desc.part.sickle_head: A curved blade that cuts a crop and the plants around it in one sweep.
modular.feedback.desc.part.maul_head: A huge blunt head. It splits wood and staggers what it hits.
modular.feedback.desc.part.glove_body: The body of a glove, worn on the hand. Leather or cloth keeps warm work and a weak shock off the skin, as far as the material stands it. Add a metacarpal plate to fight in it.
modular.feedback.desc.part.metacarpal_pl: A plate over the metacarpal bones, the back of the hand. Hard, dense plate punches harder, guards the wearer and lets a bare hand parry; a heavy one slows the swing. It keeps no heat off the hand.
modular.feedback.desc.part.knife_blade: A thin blade for a hand knife. Its edge wears with every cut.
modular.feedback.desc.part.head_blank: A block of stock hammered to seat in a Mechanical Hammer or Press. Its material, mass and shape set how hard a blow of it can land, and it is what the machine wears.
modular.feedback.desc.part.cleaver_head: A short, heavy chopping edge: four ingots of axe.
modular.feedback.desc.part.spear_head: A long spear point for a pole: reach over damage.
modular.feedback.desc.part.sword_blade: The blade of a sword: reach and a keen edge. It needs a grip.
modular.feedback.desc.part.helmet_plate: A shell for the head. Harder, thicker plate protects more and weighs more.
modular.feedback.desc.part.chestplate_pl: A shell for the chest. Harder, thicker plate protects more and weighs more.
modular.feedback.desc.part.leggings_plat: A shell for the legs. Harder, thicker plate protects more and weighs more.
modular.feedback.desc.part.boots_plate: A shell for the feet. Harder, thicker plate protects more and weighs more.
modular.feedback.desc.part.tool_tip: A hard point set into a head or blade. It bites like the tip and holds like the body.
modular.feedback.desc.part.tool_binding: Lashes or pins a head to its handle. A stronger binding holds a heavier head.
modular.feedback.desc.part.sword_guard: A crosspiece between blade and grip. It guards the hand and adds weight near it.
modular.feedback.desc.part.shield_rim: The edge that holds a shield's face together.
modular.feedback.desc.part.crossbow_prod: The bow of a crossbow. Its strength sets how hard it shoots.
modular.feedback.modifier.adjective.head: head-heavy
modular.feedback.desc.trait.flurry: Every hit on the same target within %1$s s of the last adds %2$s%% damage, up to %3$s hits. A miss, a new target, or taking a hit resets it.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.dash: Right click dashes up to %1$s blocks along your look, stopping at a wall, and cuts everything within %3$s blocks of the path for x%2$s your attack damage. Waits %4$s s between dashes.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.hack: Hits an unarmored target for x%1$s but an armored one for only x%2$s. Breaking a leaf, crop or plant also clears the plants within %3$s blocks, at %4$s wear a block swept.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.overhead: A fully charged swing also hits everything within %1$s blocks of the target for %2$s%% of the blow and knocks it back, at %3$s wear each time. A half-charged swing does only %4$s%% and no sweep.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.backstab: Hits x%1$s from behind (more than %2$s degrees off the target's facing) or on a mob with nothing targeted, and a further x%3$s when sneaking. Face to face it deals only x%4$s.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.flourish: A kill readies the next swing at once and grants speed for %1$s s. A hit does x%2$s when %3$s or more other hostiles stand within 3 blocks. Without a kill or a crowd it does nothing.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.timber: Breaking a log fells the connected logs, leaves stay, up to %1$s within %2$s blocks of the first, at %3$s extra wear a log. Sneak to fell just one; it stops short of breaking the tool.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.throw: Hold use to wind up and release to throw; a tap under %1$s s does nothing. The blow gains %2$s%% a block flown, up to x%3$s, and costs %4$s wear. It tumbles end over end, so it lands full only head-first, at some distances and not others, and it lies where it fell until picked up.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.hook: A blow the target blocks with a shield disables that shield for %1$s s and drags the target toward you (pull %2$s). With no shield to catch, the hook only snags and the blow lands at x%3$s.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.sounding: Right click sends a pulse that outlines every ore within %1$s blocks through the stone, for %2$s s, to you alone (the nearest %5$s). It reads and never mines faster; %3$s s between pulses and %4$s wear each.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.vein: Breaking an ore also breaks the connected ore of the same block, up to %1$s more, at %2$s extra wear each. Sneak to switch it off; it stops short of the tool's last point.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.spear_charge: The jab cannot land within %1$s blocks. Hold use to charge: anything between %1$s and %2$s blocks ahead that you close on at %3$s blocks a second or more is hit, harder when faster and with a heavier head; from %4$s it knocks back. The charge lasts about %5$s s, shorter if the head outweighs its binding, and each hit costs more wear the faster it lands (a point per %6$s blocks a second).
modular.feedback.desc.variant.needle: Like a tool tip, but a thin point: two pieces. The edge bites more and chips sooner.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.capped: Like a tool tip, but a thick cap: three pieces. The edge resists chipping and bites less.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.wrapped: Like a binding, but wound twice: two lengths. Holds a head on a longer handle better.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.double: Like a binding, but wound and crossed: three lengths. The strongest joint, and the most weight at the neck.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.crossguard: Like a sword guard, but a long bar: three pieces. Hold use to raise the blade and the bar takes half of a blow from the front, at a point of wear a blow.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.knuckle: Like a sword guard, but a swept hilt forged in a run of taps and heavies. Lighter, and it keeps the weight nearer the hand.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.wheel: A broad disc: two pieces. Sits further behind the hand and lowers the blade's moment.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.counterwei: A heavy knob: three pieces. A strong counterweight, and a lot of metal for it.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.banded: Like a shield rim, but a wide band: two pieces. The face holds a little more before it gives.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.flanged: Like a shield rim, but an edge turned in on itself: three pieces. The face holds much more before it gives.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.war_pick: Like a pickaxe head, but forged in a run of heavy blows into a thin spike. Hits hard and digs nothing.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.blocking: Hold use to raise the blade. The crossguard takes %1$s%% of a blow from the front and the rest comes through; each blow caught costs %2$s wear. It is a bar of metal and no shield.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.knuckles: Like a metacarpal plate, but a bar across the fingers: four ingots. Punches much harder, guards the back of the hand far less.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.claws: Like a metacarpal plate, but three prongs ground from six ingots, a good part lost as swarf. Light, so it slows the swing little. A bare-handed hit opens a bleed that keeps hurting for a few seconds, but the blow itself lands softer and the plate covers almost nothing.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.round: Like a helmet shell, a plain dome of five ingots.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.conical: Like a helmet shell, but forged to a cone. Lighter, thicker where a blow lands.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.ridged: Like a helmet shell, but with a ridge over the crown. Heavier, much thicker along the ridge.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.tailed: Like a helmet shell, but with a tail behind: six ingots, heavier.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.pointed_fa: Like a helmet shell, but drawn to a point over the face. A little heavier and thicker.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.brigandine: Like a chestplate shell, but small plates riveted under cloth: seven ingots, a little lighter, less cover. Each stud set in it bites whoever strikes you in melee.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.breastplat: Like a chestplate shell, but one solid shell: nine ingots, the heaviest. Takes a share of fall and explosion damage.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.hauberk: Like a chestplate shell, but rings, forged in a run of light taps. Cuts the damage of bladed weapons, but crushing weapons go through it.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.scale: Like a chestplate shell, but small plates overlapping like fish scales, forged in a quick run of taps. Lighter and thinner, and a point finds fewer gaps.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.lamellar: Like a chestplate shell, but laced rows of narrow plates, forged in triplets of taps. Close to the standard in weight, a little thinner.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.segmented: Like a chestplate shell, but banded hoops, forged in heavy blows. Heavier and thicker, and a point meets more plate.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.plain_legg: Like a leggings shell, as it comes.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.articulate: Like a leggings shell, forged hard and light in turn. A sprinting kick throws hostile mobs back.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.mail_chaus: Like a leggings shell, but rings, forged in a run of light taps. Cuts the damage of bladed weapons, but crushing weapons go through it.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.quilted: Like a leggings shell, but stitched padding forged flat. Light and thin.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.sabatons: Like a boots shell, but plated over the foot: six ingots, heavy. Landing from a height crushes the hostile mobs beneath, and a soft landing costs nothing.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.plain_boot: Like a boots shell, as it comes.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.wrapped_bo: Like a boots shell, but strips wound about the foot. Light and thin, quiet to wear.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.open_face: Arrows, bolts and thrown weapons do x%1$s of their damage to you. Worn once however many pieces carry it.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.closed_visor: Projectiles do only x%1$s of their damage to you, but mobs see you x%2$s as well. Worn once however many pieces carry it.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.studded: Whoever strikes you in melee takes %1$s damage for each stud set in this piece, at most %2$s, and the piece loses %3$s condition a bite. Worn once however many pieces carry it.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.collar: A critical hit or a backstab does less bonus damage to you: a stiff collar takes %1$s%% of the bonus, a flexible one (chain, leather, fibre) %2$s%%. Worn once however many pieces carry it.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.pauldron: An overhead blow does %1$s%% less to you, and so does a falling block, anvil or stalactite, at %2$s%% less. Worn once however many pieces carry it.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.poleyn: A fall does %1$s%% less damage to you, and a kick or a leg sweep staggers you %2$s%% less. Worn once however many pieces carry it.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.vambrace: With your main hand empty, or against a blow of %1$s damage or less, the forearm turns a melee blow: %2$s%% less damage and %3$s%% less shove. A disarming shot cannot pull what you hold. Worn once however many pieces carry it.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.hobnails: On ice you lose %1$s%% of the speed it gives each tick, so you do not slide; but the nails ring, and mobs see you %2$s%% better. Worn once however many pieces carry it.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.rigid: Fall and explosion damage to you is x%1$s. Worn once however many pieces carry it.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.mail: Bladed weapons (swords, axes, blades) do x%1$s to you; crushing ones (mauls, maces) do x%2$s. Worn once however many pieces carry it.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.push_through: Cobweb, powder snow and berry bushes slow you less: your mass over %5$s Mu of the slow is taken back, at most %1$s%%. Each tear costs %2$s hunger and %3$s wear, then %4$s s before the next. Worn once however many pieces carry it.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.braced: Knockback pushes you only x%1$s as far, but you swim %2$s%% slower. Worn once however many pieces carry it.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.trample: Landing from %1$s blocks or more lands on every creature within %2$s blocks, with %3$s Mu of shell added to your weight: each takes the fall by your share of the two masses and staggers by the drop's energy, and you take half the fall damage. A shockwave shoves everything nearby outward, at %4$s wear; landing on wool, snow or leaves costs no fall damage at all. Worn once however many pieces carry it.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.spurs: Starting a sprint gives speed %2$s for %1$s s, once every %3$s s. Worn once however many pieces carry it.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.scoop: Digging a shovel block also digs its neighbors across your facing, a row %1$s wide, at %2$s extra wear each. Sneak to dig one.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.quarry: Mining a pickaxe block also mines the blocks around it in the face you struck, a %1$s-wide square, at %2$s extra wear each. Sneak to mine one.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.trench: Digging a shovel block also digs the %1$s block(s) beyond it along your look, down when you look steeply down, at %2$s extra wear each. Sneak to dig one.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.kama: Tilling a block also tills the %1$s blocks beyond it, each costing the wear of a tilling, then %2$s s before the next use. Sneak to till one.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.rake: Breaking a crop draws every dropped item within %1$s blocks to your feet, at %2$s wear a stack. Sneak to leave the drops.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.scythe: Cutting a crop, leaf or plant also cuts the ring two blocks out on its level, a five-by-five with the sickle's own ring, at one wear per %1$s blocks of it. Blows on mobs land at %2$s%%. Sneak to cut one.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.billhook: A blow opens a bleed of %1$s damage a second for %2$s s that does not stack, but the blow itself lands at %3$s%%.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.reaping: Cutting a crop plants it again from its own drops, one item taken, at %1$s wear a replant. It cuts one plant at a time, no sweep. Sneak to cut without replanting.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.slam: A fully charged swing at the ground sends a shockwave: dust, a thud and a shove outward through everything within %1$s blocks, at %2$s%% strength. It spends the charge and costs %3$s wear each time.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.spring: Right click cocks the fitted spring; the next blow lets it go for the damage its volume and stiffness store, then it must be reset for %1$s s. A sword's release also lunges you forward. Armour throws the shock back into the spring (the head rates it %2$s here): worked past its rating it takes a set and stores less, far past it and it snaps, ruining part of the tool and hurting your hand. On a thrown head the spring adds to the throw instead, with almost no wind-up, and the same overload applies (rated %3$s).
modular.feedback.desc.trait.pierce: The blow ignores %1$s%% of the target's armor and toughness, and dents it: an armored target is slowed for %2$s s. Against bare flesh it is only a small hammer.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.butcher: x%1$s against animals, and each food drop of an animal it kills has a %2$s%% chance of a second helping. Against monsters it is a poor weapon, x%3$s.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.line_cut: The blow carries through the target and hits the nearest other thing in line behind it, up to %1$s blocks past, for %2$s%% of the blow; the main blow is only %3$s%%. Costs %4$s wear when the second target is struck.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.lunge: A blow struck at a run lunges for x%1$s; one struck standing still is only x%2$s.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.harpoon: Thrown on a rope %1$s blocks long, drawn from your hand. A living thing it strikes is reeled in at %2$s blocks a second (x%3$s in water, less for what resists knockback) with the harpoon still in it, then let go. It always flies back to you, arcing under gravity, and much faster if it struck nothing.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.trident: Hold use to wind up, release to throw. Riptide and Loyalty work as on a trident.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.smash: A fall onto a target lands the mace's smash: bonus damage by the fall, scaled by the head's mass, and a shove around the target.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.fork: A blow also hits up to %1$s other things in a cone ahead, within %2$s blocks, for %3$s%% of the blow each. The blow on the target is only %4$s%%. Costs %5$s wear when the tines catch more than the target.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.bearded: Like an axe head, but with an extra ingot: a heavier head that hits a little harder.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.broad_face: Like a hammer head, but six cells of stock. Heavier, so it lifts the blow ceiling by half.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.narrow_fac: Like a hammer head, but two cells of stock. Concentrates the blow: three quarters of the ceiling for half the stock.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.spring_ham: Like a maul head, but with a spring cocked inside. Right click to cock it, and the next blow lands with the stored energy.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.spring_bla: Like a spear head, but a light blade thrown from a spring: quick to throw and fast, and a heavy one overloads the spring.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.war_hammer: Like a maul head, but small. Quicker and lighter, and it staggers little; it hits through armor.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.butcher: Like a cleaver head, but trimmed. A little lighter; it is made for meat.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.bardiche: Like a cleaver head, but a long blade on a long edge. Reaches further and cuts through to the one behind.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.harpoon: Like a spear head, but a barbed head. Weak in the hand; thrown, it drags the target in.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.trident: Like a spear head, but three barbed tines. Thrust or throw; Riptide and Loyalty work.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.mace: Like a maul head, but a round block of stock. A fall onto a target lands a smash scaled by its mass.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.pitchfork: Like a spear head, but three broad prongs. Hits a crowd lightly rather than one thing hard.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.prospector: Like a pickaxe head, but thin and long. Lighter and quicker, with a keen edge that chips more easily.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.miner: Like a pickaxe head, but thick. Slower, with an edge that resists chipping.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.scoop: Like a shovel head, but wide: one more ingot of cells. Swings slower.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.trench: Like a shovel head, but narrow and thick. Hits hard and the edge is tough.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.kama: Like a hoe head, but a wide blade of three cells.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.rake: Like a hoe head, but light and thin. Quicker, and it hits weakly.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.billhook: Like a sickle head, but hooked and heavier at the tip. Hits a little harder.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.reaping_ho: Like a sickle head, but small and curved. Quick, and it hits lightly.
tooltip.feedback.part.worked: Worked to %s%% of the drawing (under: thick and heavy; over: thin and light)
forge.feedback.unmovable: No blow here moves this metal.
feedback.jei.info.hafted_tool: Every tool held by a haft is this one item: a haft with one to three faces (a pick, an axe, a blade, a point, a hammer, a file) on its front, back and top mounts. What it does is what its faces do: it digs what they dig, strips, tills or flattens as they do, smashes, charges or is thrown as its build allows, and works a grid as a hand tool when a face is a hammer. Each face wears on its own; the tool is spent only when every face is.
modular.feedback.role.casing.tip: The shell of a suit module: it carries the rest and sets its weight.
modular.feedback.role.filler.tip: Propellant powder packed in. The more of it, the bigger the blast, as a square root.
modular.feedback.role.filler_b.tip: A second powder in the blend. Fuel and oxidizer burn best balanced: too much fuel and the charge is weak and throws fire.
modular.feedback.fig.blast.tip: Explosion power of the packed filler in its casing. About 4 is a block of TNT.
modular.feedback.fig.swing_drag.tip: Share of attack speed the metacarpal plate's weight takes off every swing while the glove is worn.
modular.feedback.fig.fist.tip: Damage added to a swing with nothing in the hand. No effect on a weapon. Set by the metacarpal plate's hardness and density.
modular.feedback.fig.strike_st.tip: The most St a blow of this head carries in a Mechanical Hammer or Press, before wear. Set by its material, mass and shape, never the machine.
modular.feedback.fig.burned.tip: The share of the filler that burns. Under 0.9 the rest goes up as fire.
modular.feedback.fig.packed.tip: How many items of filler are in it.
modular.feedback.role.body.tip: The glove itself. Leather or cloth keeps warm work and a weak shock off the hand, as far as the material stands it.
modular.feedback.role.metacarpal.tip: A plate over the back of the hand. Harder, denser plate punches harder and guards you; a heavy one slows the swing. Lets a bare hand parry a melee blow.
modular.feedback.role.edge_guard.tip: A plate strip down the haft that stiffens it. It carries part of the joint's load, and costs mass and balance.
modular.feedback.role.lanyard.tip: A chain from weapon to hand. Thrown, it reels what it hits and pulls the weapon back weakly, at a cost in throw speed. Held, a disarming shot cannot strip it from you.
modular.feedback.role.rest.tip: A padded rest for the arm or stock: steadier aim.
modular.feedback.role.stabiliser.tip: A counter-mass slug on a rod: steadier hold and less kick, slower to raise.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.steady: A rest cuts the shot's spread.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.stabiliser: A counter-mass steadies the hold and cuts the shot's spread, but the weapon is slower to bring up.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.lanyard: Thrown, it reels what it hits and pulls the weapon weakly back, at a cost in throw speed. A disarming shot cannot strip it from your hand.
modular.feedback.role.laminate.tip: A layer of horn or sinew on the limbs: more energy for the length, but it weakens in damp.
modular.feedback.role.boss.tip: A metal dome on the face. It answers a turned blow with a bash and a shove, and costs mass and a weak spot.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.laminate: A horn or sinew layer: more energy for the length. An arrow loosed in rain or water goes slower.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.boss: A blow the shield turns hurts the attacker and shoves them back.
feedback.jei.info.draw_gauge: A spring balance with a hook. Hold it in one hand and a bow, a crossbow, a spring or a spring gun in the other, and use it: the draw time, launch speed and stored energy are read off the weapon and stamped on it, exact, as they were then. A stamp stays when the weapon wears; read it again to refresh it.
message.feedback.measure.nothing: Hold something made in the other hand.
feedback.readout.hardness.between: scratched by file %2$s, not by file %1$s
feedback.gloss.hint: Hold Shift: what the words mean
feedback.gloss.overloaded: load past what the run's sources can drive: the run stops
feedback.gloss.straining: load over %s%% of what the run's sources can drive
feedback.gloss.electric.live: volts at this block, and every amp asked for arrives
feedback.gloss.lamp: how much of its power the panel gets, in four steps; a step changes only when the supply moves well past the boundary
feedback.gloss.lamp.burnt: the panel took twice its rated volts and is dead for good; break it and place a new one
feedback.gloss.electric.starved: fewer amps arrive than this machine asks for
feedback.gloss.electric.blocked: a higher-voltage source on this line supplies it instead
feedback.gloss.plating.sound: coat between %1$s and %2$s Qu, one metal
feedback.gloss.plating.porous: coat under %1$s Qu: it has not closed
feedback.gloss.plating.burnt: over %4$s%% of the coat grew at more current than the piece's size takes
feedback.gloss.plating.chipped: a brittle coat loses a share to every hard hit; firing it again in a kiln restores it
feedback.gloss.plating.mixed: under %3$s%% one metal: the voltage reached a second
feedback.gloss.modular.head_heavy: balance over %s, that share of the swing's moment sitting in the head
feedback.gloss.modular.balanced: balance under %s, the moment sitting near the hand
feedback.gloss.modular.keen: edge ground to bite x%s, chipping x%s as readily
feedback.gloss.modular.blunt: edge ground to bite x%s, chipping x%s as readily
feedback.gloss.modular.brittle: edge toughness under %s of its hardness
feedback.gloss.modular.loose: joint over 1, the head levering on the joint harder than the joint carries
feedback.gloss.shield_soften: full to %s%% of the way to %s Tu, falling to %s%% at it; past it blows wear it double
feedback.compare.heading: Changed by this craft:
feedback.gloss.modular.wear: %1$s: worn past %2$s%% of its durability, figures at %3$s%%
modular.feedback.fig.balance: Balance, head's share of the swing's moment
modular.feedback.fig.joint: Joint, leverage over what it carries
modular.feedback.fig.mass.tip: Every part's volume times its material's density, added up. A heavier piece hits harder and swings slower; heavy armor slows the wearer.
modular.feedback.fig.balance.tip: How much of the swing's moment sits in the head. Near 1 is head-heavy: more force at the tip, but slower to bring round.
modular.feedback.fig.swing.tip: Swings a wielder can manage each second. Falls with the mass and how far out it sits from the hand.
modular.feedback.fig.impact.tip: Energy in one blow: the striking mass at the tip's speed. Damage and dig speed both grow with its square root.
modular.feedback.fig.bite.tip: How readily the edge cuts: its hardness against its strength, as it was ground. Scales damage and dig speed.
modular.feedback.fig.reach.tip: Extra blocks of range over the hand, from how long the handle is.
modular.feedback.fig.damage.tip: Health taken off a target by one blow at full condition. Built from bite, impact and the head's shape, less wear.
modular.feedback.fig.attack_speed.tip: Swing rate as the game counts it: swings per second, less any wear.
modular.feedback.fig.dig_speed_off.tip: How fast the second head breaks the blocks it digs.
modular.feedback.fig.hardness_off.tip: The second head's edge hardness. It gates which blocks that head can dig.
How well the second head's edge resists chipping.
modular.feedback.fig.dig_speed.tip: How fast it breaks the blocks it digs. Built from bite and impact, less wear.
modular.feedback.fig.durability.tip: Uses before it is spent: the wearing edge's volume times how well its material holds its hardness.
modular.feedback.fig.enchantability.tip: How readily enchanting takes, from the main material.
modular.feedback.fig.joint.tip: The leverage the head puts on the joint, over what the handle and binding can carry. Over 1 it works loose.
modular.feedback.fig.hardness.tip: The wearing edge's hardness. It gates which blocks the item can dig.
modular.feedback.fig.edge_toughness.tip: How well the edge resists chipping. Hard, brittle edges chip on what a tough one shrugs off.
modular.feedback.fig.armour_toughness.ti: Blunts hard hits that armor points alone would let through.
modular.feedback.fig.knockback_resistanc: Share of knockback the wearer shrugs off, from the plate's density; on boots, a coat grippier than the plate adds to it and a slicker one takes from it.
modular.feedback.fig.slow.tip: Share of walking speed the wearer gives up to carry the mass past what is free.
modular.feedback.fig.capacity.tip: The most damage a shield stops outright.
modular.feedback.fig.draw.tip: Ticks to draw the bow; fewer is quicker.
modular.feedback.fig.velocity.tip: Launch speed against a vanilla bow's.
modular.feedback.fig.corrosion.tip: 0 to 1: how well it survives water, the wearing part's own and any coat's together.
gui.feedback.tool_table.status.no_hammer: Put a hand hammer in the hammer slot.
gui.feedback.tool_table.status.cold: The stock is not at working heat.
gui.feedback.tool_table.tip.hammer: A hand hammer. Every act here costs it a point.
gui.feedback.tool_table.tip.plan: A blueprint, for the types that need one (the crossbow).
feedback.jei.circuit_chain.note1: Click any item for its own recipes.
feedback.jei.circuit_chain.note2: Cheapest route: printed board, coherer, tin.
gui.feedback.solder.title: Soldering
feedback.jei.soldering.note: Hand iron: drag along the pad row, pace sets the joint. Or reflow oven. Etched traces lift at their wire's limit.
feedback.jei.info.coherer: Open until a nearby spark welds its grains into a wire; it stays welded until you tap it with an empty hand. A spark is an arc from a breaker or relay opening under load, or an electrostatic generator.
feedback.jei.info.whisker: A wire on a crystal. Right-click with a crystal to seat it, then step the whisker round its 8 spots with an empty hand to find one that works. On a spark it closes the line for half a second.
feedback.jei.info.relay: Put it against an electromagnet. A small current in the magnet's line closes the relay's own line. It wears when it switches under load.
feedback.jei.info.component_tester: Right-click a placed whisker, coherer or relay to read how it responds. With a trace board in the other hand, right-click in the air to read the board.
feedback.jei.info.oscilloscope: Put it against a cable and against a phosphor screen. It only reads: right-click for the last 16 samples. A signal pegged at the top is exact and wrong.
feedback.jei.info.phosphor_screen: Set it on a firebox, heat it, then right-click with an empty hand to seal it. The hotter the seal, the better the vacuum. Pair it with an oscilloscope. Holding it at full brightness burns it in.
feedback.jei.info.reflow_oven: Set it on a firebox. Right-click with pasted boards to load up to four, empty hand to take them out: joints are set from the hottest they got and how long they sat above the solder's melting point.
feedback.jei.info.soldering_iron: Right-click a fire to heat it. Right-click with a pasted board in the other hand to open the soldering screen, then hold the button and drag the tip along the pad row. Pace is the skill: too fast and a pad stays dull (cold), too slow and it scorches and the trace lifts, a shaky hand bridges. The iron cools as it works, so later pads want a slower pace. Reheat and come back to start again.
feedback.jei.info.diamond_grinding_wheel: A grinding wheel with diamond grit: hard enough to cut quartz and amethyst into crystal plates, and to grind a plate one cut finer. Sits on a shaft line like the stone wheel.
feedback.jei.info.mass_probe: Hang it in an electrolytic cell to read how much metal has plated onto it. Its cut is the cut of the crystal plate it was made from: fine sees detail and not far, coarse sees far and coarsely.
feedback.jei.info.trace_board: Make a substrate on a grinding wheel, lay traces (etched or printed) in a crafting grid, mount parts, paste with solder, then solder it with an iron or reflow oven.
feedback.jei.info.circuit: A soldered board with parts on it. It carries elements, speed, noise and joints, read with a component tester. A cold joint gives a noisy circuit; lifted traces give a dead one.
feedback.jei.info.galena: A rectifying crystal. Seat it in a cat's whisker detector, or mount it on a trace board as a switching part.
feedback.jei.info.pyrite: A rectifying crystal, poorer than galena. Seat it in a cat's whisker detector, or mount it on a trace board as a switching part.
feedback.jei.fire.title: Fired %s coat
feedback.jei.fire.output: The part, coated %s Qu; a chipped coat is made whole
feedback.jei.dip.overrun: Past %s Qu in all the part takes flaws, then dissolves
feedback.jei.info.electrolytic_cell: Fill it with water and wire it to a supply. Hang a metal on top: it dissolves into the water, and the current plates metal back out onto the cathode. The voltage decides which metal plates; the current decides how fast. Hang a metal piece on a side and it takes the coat instead. Nothing stops when the anode is gone.
feedback.jei.info.gloves: Worn in the hands slot, a glove of leather or cloth keeps warm work and a weakly live bare wire off the skin, as far as the material stands it: enough to ladle from a lit furnace. A metacarpal plate on the back of the hand punches harder, guards you and lets a bare hand parry, but a heavy one slows your swing; it keeps no heat off.
feedback.jei.info.hand_hammer: Put it in a crafting grid with one workpiece: each craft is one blow, and the result slot shows what that blow would make. Sneak-scroll chooses how hard you swing. A blow that cannot land -- metal too hard or too cold -- offers no craft.
feedback.jei.hot_tool.hot: Heat it to its working temperature first
feedback.jei.info.hot_tool: Hammered out hot: a striking hand tool (the hammer) and the metal pieces, in any arrangement in a crafting grid, with every piece at its metal's working temperature. A cold piece makes nothing, and the hammer wears one point per tool.
feedback.jei.info.tongs: Two rods of one metal at their working temperature, a grip and a striking hand tool (the hammer), in any arrangement in a crafting grid. Held in one hand, they let you carry hot work in the other. How hot depends on what the grip and the arms are made of.
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.pick_part: Pick a part to choose its material and shape.
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.needs_haft: A haft is needed to hold this head.
message.feedback.blueprint_table.cannot_: Cannot print: this type is not put together that way.
Cannot print: the action and feed do not work together, or a part's material cannot be built into a gun.
Cannot print: these parts are a gun on paper, but the Engineering Table would not read them back as this design.
Cannot print: these parts are a gun, but it has no firing figures to bake.
modular.feedback.desc.part.bow_limbs: The arms of a bow: three lengths of stock bent to a draw. Their strength sets how hard it shoots.
modular.feedback.desc.part.shield_face: The broad face of a shield. Its material sets what blow it can take; its shape sets what the shield is.
modular.feedback.desc.part.receiver: The body of a gun: it holds the chamber, the action and the stock. Its shape sets what kind of gun it is.
modular.feedback.desc.part.gun_barrel: The tube the bullet runs down. A longer barrel gives a faster, truer shot; its bore sets the caliber it takes.
modular.feedback.desc.part.slide: A sliding block that cycles the action. It lets a gun load itself from the recoil or the gas.
modular.feedback.desc.part.bolt: Seals the breech and works the action by hand, by lever, by pump, by break or by itself.
modular.feedback.desc.part.trigger_group: The trigger and the sear it releases. It is what makes the gun fire when you ask.
modular.feedback.desc.part.cylinder: A drum of chambers that turns a round into line at each pull. A revolver's whole feed.
modular.feedback.desc.part.magazine_tube: A tube of rounds under or beside the barrel. It feeds the action one round at a time.
modular.feedback.desc.part.belt_feed: Pulls a belt of rounds through the action. It feeds a machine gun as long as the belt lasts.
modular.feedback.desc.part.sight: Shows where the shot will go. A better sight tightens the aim, never the gun.
modular.feedback.desc.part.suppressor: Slows the muzzle gas to quiet the shot. It holds heat in the can and gets hot.
modular.feedback.desc.part.muzzle_brake: Vents gas sideways at the muzzle to cut kick. The blast at the sides grows louder.
modular.feedback.desc.part.thermal_sleev: A sleeve shrunk onto the barrel. Loose cold, it closes on the barrel as it heats and tightens the group; left to get too hot it grips the bore and squeezes the chamber.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.thermal_fit: Loose when cold, tightest at a warm barrel, binding when it runs too hot.
modular.feedback.desc.part.sculk_jacket: A jacket that stores the barrel's vibration. Cold, it quiets the barrel and tightens the group; once the barrel is hot the stored vibration spoils and the group opens wider than bare.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.sculk_jacket: Tight while the barrel is cold, worse than bare once it is hot.
modular.feedback.desc.part.resonance_wei: A weight threaded on the barrel. Where it sits tunes the barrel to one muzzle speed: a round near it shoots tight, a round far from it shoots worse than a bare barrel.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.resonance: Tuned to one muzzle speed; the further the round is from it, the wider the group.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.thread_bre: Tuned for slow rounds, about 250 m/s.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.thread_mid: Tuned for a middling round, about 450 m/s.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.thread_muz: Tuned for fast rounds, about 800 m/s.
modular.feedback.desc.part.counterweight: A dense mass that runs against the bolt and cancels kick. It slows the cycle, and a worn bore cuts its stroke short so it slaps the receiver instead.
modular.feedback.desc.part.bipod: Folding legs under the barrel. Crouched and still, they take the kick and tighten the group.
modular.feedback.desc.part.bayonet: A lug and blade under the barrel, for a thrust with the gun in hand.
modular.feedback.desc.part.selector_swit: A switch on the trigger group that lets the gun fire in bursts or automatic.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.counterweigh: Cancels kick and slows the cycle; wear makes it slap.
modular.feedback.desc.part.eddy_sleeve: A conductive sleeve at the muzzle. A bullet of the right metal drags on it as it leaves and slows.
modular.feedback.desc.part.relief_vent: A port in the receiver that bleeds gas when pressure climbs too high, sparing the gun some overpressure.
modular.feedback.desc.part.obturator: A ring set in the chamber mouth. Soft stuff seals better; fire eats it.
modular.feedback.desc.part.hydraulic_buf: A sealed chamber of thick fluid behind the bolt, taking the recoil.
modular.feedback.desc.part.lit_reticle: A speck of glowing mineral set in the sight.
modular.feedback.desc.part.magnetic_sear: A small magnet that holds the sear against the trigger.
modular.feedback.desc.part.barrel_shroud: A jacket round the barrel. It sheds heat to the air so the gun cools sooner.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.recurve: Like bow limbs, but forged with a curl in each tip in a run of taps and heavy blows. A full draw hits harder and passes through a mob; a part draw is only an ordinary bow, and the draw is a little slower.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.hunting: Like bow limbs, but forged in a steady run of taps and left light. The shot is silent and an arrow to an animal's head hits much harder; it flies slower and hits softer on anything else.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.arbalest: Like a crossbow prod, but huge: four lengths of stock. Each bolt hits far harder and passes through two mobs, but loading takes more than twice as long and slows you.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.pistol: Like a crossbow prod, but a single length of stock. Loads in under half the time; the bolt is slow and light, so it is a short-range weapon.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.repeater: Like a crossbow prod, but forged with a rack in a run of light taps and heavies. One load takes three bolts from the quiver and one shot looses them all, scattered; each hits a little softer and loading takes longer.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.kite: Like a shield face, but long and tapered: five lengths of stock. A projectile it stops is sent back where you look and hardly wears it; a melee blow is held to less.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.snap_shot: The draw takes %1$s%% of the time, and the arrow leaves at %2$s%% of the speed (and so of the damage).
modular.feedback.desc.trait.heavy_draw: The draw takes %1$s%% of the time and the arrow leaves at %2$s%% of the speed, which is damage as well as range. While drawn it slows you by %3$s%%.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.heavy_bolt: Loading takes %1$s%% of the time. Each bolt does %2$s%% damage and passes through %3$s mobs. While loading it slows you by %4$s%%.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.snap_bolt: Loading takes %1$s%% of the time. The bolt leaves at %2$s%% of the speed and does %3$s%% damage.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.recurve: A full draw shoots an arrow that does %1$s%% more damage and passes through %2$s mob. A part draw gets neither. The draw takes %3$s%% of the time.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.stalker: The shot makes no sound. An arrow to an animal's head does x%1$s damage. The arrow leaves at %2$s%% of the speed and the draw takes %3$s%% of the time.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.repeater: Loading takes %1$s bolts from the quiver at once and one shot looses them all, scattered (x%4$s the usual spread). Loading takes %2$s%% of the time and each bolt does %3$s%% damage.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.parry: This shield parries on the parry key: a blow that lands in the %1$s s window is stopped whole and throws the attacker back. Raised for plain blocking it guards only a %2$s degree arc ahead and holds %3$s%% of what its face could.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.deflect: This shield deflects on the parry key: a projectile that lands in the window is sent back the way you look at %1$s%% of its speed. It does not parry a melee blow, and raised for plain blocking holds one to %2$s%% of what the face could.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.bulwark: Guards every angle once raised and holds %1$s%% of what a plain face could, but slows you %2$s%% and wears %3$s%% as fast. Use it while sprinting to bash instead: hostiles within %4$s blocks ahead take %5$s damage and are thrown back, at a cost of wear, hunger, your sprint and %6$s s before the shield can be raised again.
modular.feedback.role.box_feed.tip: A box of rounds that feeds the action: reloads in one piece, and holds more rounds than a tube.
modular.feedback.role.thermal_sleeve.tip: A sleeve round the barrel that tightens as it heats: a cold barrel throws wider, a warm one groups tighter, a hot one binds.
modular.feedback.role.counterweight.tip: A weight in the buffer: less kick, a slower cycle, and a slap of kick when the action returns.
modular.feedback.role.bipod.tip: Folding legs under the gun: much less kick and spread when braced.
modular.feedback.role.bayonet.tip: A blade on the barrel lug: lets you stab with the gun in hand.
modular.feedback.role.selector.tip: A switch on the receiver that gives select fire.
modular.feedback.role.sculk_jacket.tip: A sculk-lined jacket on the barrel: tighter spread while cold, but it spoils and throws wide when it goes off.
modular.feedback.role.resonance.tip: A weight threaded on the barrel that tunes its ring: further toward the muzzle tunes a slower shot.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.handgun: Held in one hand, no stock: nothing braces it, so kick and spread are the wrist's. Pistol, revolver, derringer and machine pistol are all this.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.machine_gu: A heavy frame built for sustained fire from an open bolt. Its trouble is heat, not aim.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.self_loadi: Cycles off the shot, one round a pull.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.automatic: Cycles off the shot and keeps firing while the trigger is held; select fire.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.bolt: A manual bolt: slow between shots, locked tight into the barrel.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.lever: Worked by a lever under the grip; a hammer strikes the primer.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.pump: Worked by a sliding forend; a hammer strikes the primer.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.break: The barrels hinge open to load; a hammer strikes the primer.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.revolver: Rounds wait in a turning cylinder; with a hammer it can be fanned.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.belt: The rounds are a chain: a long reload, and a belt as long as the chain.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.reflex: Aims with a modest zoom, quickly raised.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.scope: A lot of zoom, slowly raised.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.hammer: A hammer strikes the primer. It lets a cylinder be fitted and fanned.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.manual_cycle: The next round is brought up by the shooter: this much longer between shots, in the cycle figure.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.select_fire: Semi, burst or full automatic, switched in hand.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.double_barre: Two barrels side by side. Sneaking while you pull fires both at once for one recoil.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.closed_bolt: A round sits in the hot chamber: above its charge's ignition temperature it cooks off on its own.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.blowback: Only the bolt's mass holds the breech shut. A round that makes more than %1$s Pu kicks harder in proportion and wears the bore x%2$s faster by the excess.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.lockup: How firmly the action holds the breech shut: the chamber is rated at %1$s%% of the barrel's hoop strength, and the group is tighter by %2$s%%.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.gas_operated: The gas works the action: a cycle %1$s%% quicker that pressure does not hurt, paid in %2$s%% more heat and %3$s Mu of piston.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.off_hand: Fires from the off hand on the use key. A one-handed gun in each hand fires one on each button, each with its own count; a reload then takes much longer.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.bayonet: A fixed blade under the barrel. Gun-fu Bayonet Drill thrusts with it.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.gun_braced: Crouched and still, the stock or the frame takes the kick: %1$s%% less kick and %2$s%% tighter.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.open_bolt: Fires from an open bolt: nothing in the chamber to cook off. After %1$s s without firing the first shot sprays x%2$s wider.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.belt_fed: The rounds are a chain: a reload takes x%1$s as long.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.fan: Crouched, hold the attack button to slap the hammer as fast as the hand can: a rate no cycle limit gives, with the spread, kick and cylinder heat that costs.
feedback.gloss.modular.overstressed: the reference charge makes more pressure than the chamber is rated for (overpressure above 1)
modular.feedback.fig.peak_pressure.tip: What the reference charge makes in the case.
modular.feedback.fig.chamber_rating.tip: The most the chamber holds: the barrel's metal and wall. Past it the gun takes the force.
modular.feedback.fig.muzzle_speed.tip: How fast the bullet leaves, at the reference load.
modular.feedback.fig.muzzle_energy.tip: Energy delivered to the bullet, in Fu: bore, barrel length and pressure.
modular.feedback.fig.impulse.tip: Momentum of bullet and gas: what recoil is made from.
modular.feedback.fig.cycle.tip: Time between shots, including the hand's work on a manual action.
modular.feedback.fig.spread.tip: Cone half-angle at the muzzle; never zero.
modular.feedback.fig.kick.tip: Camera kick per shot: impulse over the gun's mass, less what the grip lets through.
modular.feedback.fig.report.tip: How loud a shot is against an open muzzle.
modular.feedback.fig.heat_factor.tip: Heat a shot leaves in the gun against an open muzzle.
modular.feedback.fig.shed_factor.tip: How fast the barrel sheds heat against a bare one.
modular.feedback.fig.overpressure.tip: Charge pressure over the chamber rating. Above 1 the force goes into the gun.
gun.feedback.build: %1$s mm bore, %2$s m barrel, %3$s mm wall, %4$s sight, %5$s
gui.feedback.tool_table.tip.round: A loaded round. Nothing is spent.
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.rig.tip: Test rig: runs the drawn item in a loop. Swing speed, reach, dig pace, draw, launch speed, joint and shield capacity are the figures beside it, moving.
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.joint: %1$s and %2$s: this joint is at %3$s%% of its limit
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.pin.tip: Pin this draft. Each pinned draft puts a colored mark on every bar to compare against; up to three.
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.unpin: Click to open a pinned draft, Shift-click to drop it.
message.feedback.blueprint_table.fault.f: This action cannot work this feed.
message.feedback.blueprint_table.fault.s: A second barrel needs a break action with no feed.
message.feedback.blueprint_table.fault.f: Only one feed fits a gun.
message.feedback.blueprint_table.fault.m: This part's material cannot be built into a gun.
message.feedback.blueprint_table.fault.s: A long gun or machine gun receiver needs a stock.
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.remove: Take this part off the drawing
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.paper: Blueprint paper. A printed one opens to edit.
modular.feedback.role.barrel.tip: Where the bullet is guided. Its bore sets the caliber; length sets muzzle speed against weight.
modular.feedback.role.receiver.tip: The frame everything else bolts to. In a powder gun its shape decides what kind of gun this is; in a spring gun it is what the spring is rated against.
modular.feedback.role.second_barrel.tip: A second tube beside the first. Two shots ready, more weight and kick to hold.
modular.feedback.role.slide.tip: Reciprocating cover that cycles the action by blowback: self-loading.
modular.feedback.role.bolt.tip: A bolt that locks the breech: a stronger action, worked by hand or gas.
modular.feedback.role.trigger.tip: Releases the action. Sits in the receiver.
modular.feedback.role.grip.tip: What the hand holds. Sets how the gun settles under recoil.
modular.feedback.role.cylinder.tip: A rotating drum of chambers fed in turn: a revolver.
modular.feedback.role.tube.tip: A tube under the barrel holding rounds in a row.
modular.feedback.role.belt.tip: A belt of linked rounds feeding a machine gun.
modular.feedback.role.sight.tip: Aiming aid. Tightens how well you hit where you point.
modular.feedback.role.suppressor.tip: Baffled can on the muzzle: quieter and less flash, at some cost to speed.
modular.feedback.role.muzzle_brake.tip: Vents gas sideways to tame recoil.
modular.feedback.role.eddy_sleeve.tip: A conducting sleeve on the muzzle that drags a magnetic bullet as it passes.
modular.feedback.role.vent.tip: Lets heat and gas out of the action.
modular.feedback.role.obturator.tip: A soft ring that seals a loose chamber: the softer the stuff, the less kick and the tighter the group. Burns away once the barrel is hotter than the stuff can take.
modular.feedback.role.hydraulic_buffer.t: A sealed chamber of thick fluid the recoil must push through: much less kick, a slower cycle. The fluid thins as the barrel heats. Must be made of something sticky.
modular.feedback.role.lit_reticle.tip: A dot of glowing mineral in the sight, with no battery to run flat. Tightens the group in the dark; washed out in daylight. Must be made of something luminous.
modular.feedback.role.magnetic_sear.tip: A magnet holds the sear: a cleaner break and a quicker reset, with no power drawn waiting. Its pull fades as the barrel heats, and a non-magnetic stuff has none.
modular.feedback.role.shroud.tip: A cover around the barrel that sheds heat.
modular.feedback.role.head.tip: The business end. Its material and shape set damage and dig speed.
modular.feedback.role.second_head.tip: The other end of a twin-headed tool.
modular.feedback.role.handle.tip: What you hold. Longer handles reach further and swing slower.
modular.feedback.role.binding.tip: Lashing where head meets handle. Takes some of the shock.
modular.feedback.role.tip.tip: A hard piece set into the working edge. Lends it hardness.
modular.feedback.role.blade.tip: The cutting part. Its material sets edge, wear and damage.
modular.feedback.role.guard.tip: Stops a blow sliding down onto the hand.
modular.feedback.role.pommel.tip: Counterweight at the hand end: moves the balance back.
modular.feedback.role.haft.tip: The long shaft of a polearm.
modular.feedback.role.shaft.tip: The long body: stiffer shafts fly truer.
modular.feedback.role.face.tip: The striking face of a shield or mace.
modular.feedback.role.rim.tip: Edge of a shield, takes the brunt of blows.
modular.feedback.role.limbs.tip: The springy arms of a bow: they store the energy.
modular.feedback.role.string.tip: Carries the limbs' energy to the arrow.
modular.feedback.role.lock.tip: The flint and its hammer. Pulling the trigger snaps the flint on the pan: it takes a moment to prime and cock again, and the priming sometimes flashes without firing the charge.
modular.feedback.role.pivot.tip: The hinge the blades turn on.
modular.feedback.role.plate.tip: The main armor. Better plate takes more of every blow.
modular.feedback.role.lining.tip: Padding worn under the plate; it softens what gets through.
modular.feedback.role.studs.tip: Hard studs set into plate. They bite whoever strikes you in melee.
modular.feedback.role.collar.tip: A ring about the neck: it takes a share of a critical hit or a backstab. Plate is stiff and takes more; chain and leather give.
modular.feedback.role.pauldron.tip: A plate over the shoulder: it turns overhead blows and falling blocks.
modular.feedback.role.poleyn.tip: Caps over the knee: they soften a fall and a kick.
modular.feedback.role.vambrace.tip: A cuff on the forearm: it turns a light blow when the hand is empty and keeps a disarm from taking the hand's hold.
modular.feedback.role.spurs.tip: Spurs on the heel: starting a sprint gives a burst of speed.
modular.feedback.role.hobnails.tip: Nails through the sole: they bite ice but ring on stone.
modular.feedback.role.underlayer.tip: Padding or mail worn under the plate; it softens what gets through.
modular.feedback.role.spring.tip: A spring of wire or rod fitted to the weapon. Its volume and stiffness set what it stores; the head it sits in sets what it can take.
modular.feedback.role.magazine.tip: A box of plate or plank on the crossbow. Its volume sets how many bolts a load takes.
modular.feedback.role.cooling.tip: Fins or a water jacket on a motor housing. More material sheds more heat.
message.feedback.blueprint_table.no_pape: Put paper in the slot to print.
item.feedback.unlearning_token.used: You unlearn everything. Your points are returned.
item.feedback.unlearning_token.nothing: You have learned nothing to unlearn.
skill.feedback.tree.chaos.desc: Leaves targets with what you did to them, and it spreads: worn armor stays worn, stripped weapons stay stripped, fire passes to the next body, a shove knocks one body into another.
skill.feedback.move.rend.desc: Cast: a short blow that grinds the target's worn armor. Each piece loses durability by your weapon's hardness against that piece's, and your weapon is worn in turn by the hardest piece struck. Nothing worn, nothing happens. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.sunder.desc: Cast: a heavy blow into the shield or weapon the target holds. A raised shield is split and disabled; a held weapon is worn, and struck from the hand to lie on the ground if yours is half again as hard. Your weapon is worn by theirs. Rearms when you stagger something. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.kindle.desc: Cast: touch a held item above the burn line to the ground ahead. Every flammable block and living thing within two blocks catches fire, burning longer the hotter the item, and the fire passes to bodies beside them. The item cools by what it lit and scalds your hand. Rearms on a landed blow. Costs 20 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.barge.desc: Cast: a shoulder into the body ahead. It is staggered by your mass (armor counts) and sent along your line, faster the more you outweigh it; whatever it meets is staggered by its own mass at that speed. A body too heavy to move is not shoved. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.stampede.desc: Cast: a roar that sends every burning creature within nine blocks bolting away from you at a gallop, carrying their fire into whatever they pass. Rearms when you stagger something. Costs 20 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_powder_burn.d: A close shot leaves a powder burn on the target for ten seconds, up to five stacked; your next melee blow spends them as damage. Price: you have to get close, and the burn fades.
skill.feedback.figure.carry_ratio: Carry up to %s times more of your weight
skill.feedback.move.fist_jab.desc: Standing on the ground, an unarmed blow reaches a little further. Price: only standing; it is the start of the chain. A move landing soon after the one before it in the chain hits 30% harder.
skill.feedback.move.fist_lunge.desc: A sprinting unarmed blow staggers half again as hard and guards you for a few ticks. Price: you have to be at a run, and it comes after Jab. A move landing soon after the one before it in the chain hits 30% harder.
skill.feedback.move.fist_sweep.desc: A standing unarmed blow also strikes everything across a wide arc in front of you at part damage. Price: standing still, and it comes after Jab. A move landing soon after the one before it in the chain hits 30% harder.
skill.feedback.move.fist_chop.desc: A falling unarmed blow drives the target down. Price: you have to be falling; it follows a Lunge. A move landing soon after the one before it in the chain hits 30% harder.
skill.feedback.move.rising_uppercut.desc: Upgrade to Uppercut. Crouch while casting it and a landed punch drives you up with the body, the same height. Landing from that height is yours to take. A miss still staggers you.
skill.feedback.move.uppercut.desc: Cast: bare-handed. A quick windup, then one punch for seven damage, plus the fist damage of a worn plate, that launches a body about seven blocks up. A miss leaves you staggered for a moment. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_brand.desc: A whip with the barrel above the burn line sears the target by the barrel's temperature, and the barrel gives up some heat. The more you fired first, the harder it brands. Price: you shot to get it hot, and a hot barrel burns your own hand.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_muzzle_stagge: A point-blank shot just after a whip lands its impulse as stagger on the target, over the target's mass: a heavy bore shoves hard, a small one barely. Price: you have to be on top of them; spent until you land a blow.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_bayonet.desc: With a bayonet lug fitted the swing is a thrust that rides the gun's own cycle, hitting by the bayonet metal's hardness. Price: the lug is a part you must build and carry.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_braced.desc: Recoil is momentum. Opens the recoil techniques.
A shot fired airborne or against a surface pushes you by the gun's impulse over your mass: a rifle launches you, a pocket pistol nudges. Price: a hot or worn gun wears faster when used as a thruster.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_braced_fire.d: Shooting braced (crouched against a block, or in the air against a wall) sheds most of the heat bloom of the spread. Price: it needs terrain.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_hot_clear.des: Sneak-reload with the barrel near cook-off ejects the chambered round unfired. Price: it only helps where cook-off is a danger.
Rolling through an attack clears the gun's cycle wait, so the next shot is ready at once. Price: the roll has to cross a blow, and it rearms on the clock.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_spent_case_dr: Reloading during a roll takes only as long as the roll has left. Price: the reload still needs the roll to be long enough.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_return_fire.d: A weapon parry in its window turns a bullet back at the shooter carrying the round's own energy, not a multiple. Price: the parry timing, and the blow wears the weapon.
skill.feedback.move.quake_leap.desc: Cast: vault forward and up, and land hard. The landing shoves everything within reach and staggers it by your mass (armor counts) and how far you fell, over each target's own mass. A heavy armored fighter shakes the ground. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.whirl.desc: Cast: a full turn with the held weapon, striking everything in reach at four-fifths of its damage and staggering it by that damage over its mass. Rearms when you stagger something, so it chains off a parry or a kick. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.forge_slam.desc: Cast: slam a held item above the burn line into the ground. A ring of searing goes out by its temperature, and the item gives up heat to it, more the more it burns. A forge-fresh blade is a bomb for one swing. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.flurry.desc: Cast, empty-handed: six quick blows on whoever you face, the last one a stagger. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.pummel_pin.desc: Rider on Pummel: a target light enough to grab is held still for all six blows, in mid-air too, and so are you. If it is still hanging in the air at the last blow, that blow launches it hard the way you look, down included. Bodies too heavy to grab are not pinned; among the rest, lighter ones fly farther.
skill.feedback.move.shadow_step.desc: Cast: vanish and step in behind the nearest thing in front of you, within nine blocks, on the side it is not facing. Needs room to stand there. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.ambush.desc: The first blow within three seconds of a Shadow step staggers its target, by the blow over its mass, tripled, whatever it was facing. The step is the opening; a dagger's backstab is a different thing (the weapon's own).
skill.feedback.move.walking_fire.desc: Cast: three rounds from the held gun, each laid on the next target in front of you, so one press sweeps a room. Every round heats the barrel and spends ammo as usual. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.muzzle_flash.desc: Cast: fire the gun as a blast. The round's baked impulse is the stagger of everything in the cone in front, and the flash blinds it. A heavy bore staggers a lot, a light one barely. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.dead_eye.desc: Always on: a shot taken crouched and standing still leaves exact, with no spread, and its round counts as twice as hard against armor.
skill.feedback.move.dropkick.desc: Cast, in the air: dive forward and down; the landing is a kick on whatever is under you, by your mass (armor counts) over its. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.brace.desc: Always on while crouched: knockback cannot move you, and every blow taken is held by your mass (armor counts) against the attacker's. The held share is not taken, it goes into the attacker as stagger, and the held weapon wears for it.
skill.feedback.move.shield_wall.desc: Cast, with a shield or blocking item in hand: for three seconds anything that comes at you inside the cone in front is turned back and staggered once, by its mass and speed. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.reckoning.desc: Cast: the damage your parries took in the last ten seconds is banked, and this lets it go as one blow at what you face, staggering it by twice that. The harder you were hit, the harder it lands. Rearms when you stagger something. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.reprisal.desc: Always on: every parry you land is answered at once with a blow at whoever struck, for your attack damage, and staggers them.
skill.feedback.move.pin_down.desc: Always on, with a gun: any round you fire that passes close to a living thing slows it hard for two seconds, hit or not. The crack of a near miss is what pins them; area denial from a gun that is not trying to hit.
skill.feedback.move.hamstring.desc: Cast: a low cut at what you face, for seven tenths of the weapon's damage, that cripples its legs: slowed hard for four seconds. A fighter that cannot close or flee is a fighter you choose the range against. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.mark_and_fire.desc: Held cast, with a hammer-and-cylinder gun (a revolver): hold the key and your sights on things, and each beat marks one more of the rounds chambered, a thing can take several. Let go, fill the cylinder or run dry of stamina, and the hammer lets go: you swing round to each mark in turn and put an exact shot in it, two ticks apart. You walk slowly while laying it and have six seconds. Every round still heats the barrel and spends ammo. Costs 10 stamina, then 4 a second while held.
skill.feedback.move.coin_flip.desc: Cast: toss a coin and shoot it. A harder coin than the round rebounds it to the nearest thing within 24 blocks that has a clear line from the coin, seen or not; a softer one is punched through. Heavy coins slow the round. Price: a stamped coin, 15 stamina, and it rearms when you land a blow, or after 30 s out of a fight.
skill.feedback.move.second_mark.desc: The coin cast may be used twice: a second coin goes up while the first is still in the air, with no rearm of its own. A rebound goes into the other coin first, so you can shoot a coin into a coin and on to a target. Price: a second stamped coin and a second 15 stamina, and the shot has to be fast.
skill.feedback.move.round_the_corner.des: The rebound looks three times as far for a target. Price: it still needs a clear line from the coin, and it gives up the second press.
skill.feedback.move.searing_strike.desc: Any held item above the burn line sears what a landed blow hits: a blade fresh from the fire, never keyed on what it is. The item cools. Price: a hot hand burns you, and the heat is spent.
skill.feedback.move.feint.desc: With a one-handed weapon in each hand, an off-hand strike pressed while your main hand is mid-swing cuts in at once at full strength and the target flinches. Price: spent until you land a blow.
skill.feedback.move.draw_switch.desc: Swapping to a weapon of a different build family gives you the swing back at once instead of restarting the recharge. Price: you carry two kinds of weapon, and it rearms on the clock.
skill.feedback.move.last_stand.desc: Taking a hit that leaves you at 3 hearts or less makes the next roll that swallows a blow a free parry: the attacker is staggered and your riposte opens. Price: it takes a hit to arm, and it rearms only by the clock.
skill.feedback.move.kick.desc: Cast: drive a kick into whatever is in front: a stagger from your mass (armor counts) against the target's. Needs the skill; gear can grant it. Wall Smash and Breach Kick build on it.
skill.feedback.move.grab.desc: Cast: take hold of what is in front of you, bare-handed. A worn glove improves it: a longer hold, and heavier targets. Throw and the grip nodes build on it.
skill.feedback.move.shove.desc: Cast, held: put your hands on a vehicle body and keep the key down. A body no heavier than you and your armor (the carry ratio) is held up in front of the camera like a prop. A heavier one is shoved along the ground as you walk or sprint, or dragged back as you step away, by your mass times your speed at the point you touched, and it pushes back on you equally; its tires' grip and brake pads do the resisting, so a braked car stays put. Costs stamina for the work you deliver, and more to hold up more weight. Standing on a body, or being pulled too far from it, lets go. Pushing a body earns Brute points, fewer the more you repeat it.
skill.feedback.move.throw.desc: Release a staggered body you have pulled in (a grab, or a grapple that reached you) past you along your look; mass decides how far, and whatever stands there does the rest. Price: you are left in reach, recovering. Spent until you stagger something.
skill.feedback.move.size_up.desc: Cast: read the creature under your crosshair (twenty-four blocks, in sight) for fifteen seconds. The action bar gives its armour, toughness and health and what it is giving away right now: facing away, unaware, burning, wet or staggered. Every weakness skill here works only on a read creature, with any weapon. Costs 15 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.hardness_gap.desc: A blow on a read creature lands harder the harder your weapon's edge is than the armour it wears: 3% per point of hardness between them, up to 40%. Iron on leather finds seams; iron on a hard plate finds none. A creature in no armour has no seams. Any weapon, a bare hand counts as soft.
skill.feedback.move.soft_spot.desc: Cast: pick the worn piece under your crosshair (head, chest, legs or feet, by height) on a read creature. The next blow within three seconds ignores that piece: 4% per point of its armour and toughness, up to 50%. A bare slot costs nothing and tells you so. Costs 25 stamina; rearms on a strike.
skill.feedback.move.opening.desc: A blow on a read creature lands harder for each opening it shows: facing away (25%), unaware or asleep (25%), burning (20%), wet (10%), staggered (30%), up to 80%. Any weapon.
skill.feedback.move.exploit.desc: Cast: spend the read on one blow. For three seconds the next hit on that creature lands 50% harder, plus every opening it shows, and the read is used up. Needs a read creature under the crosshair. Costs 30 stamina; rearms on a strike.
skill.feedback.move.tell.desc: A read creature gives itself away when it swings: for a dozen ticks after it hits anything it is open, 30% more to the next blow. Read its rhythm and punish the recovery.
skill.feedback.move.pressure_point.desc: A blow on a read creature that is staggered or just swung staggers it again by mass ratio: a light fighter can topple a heavy body, a heavy one barely moves. Rearms stagger casts.
skill.feedback.move.culling.desc: A read creature under 30% health is open: 20% more to the blow that ends it. Any weapon.
skill.feedback.move.edge.desc: A blow on a read creature with a drop, lava, fire, a magma block or a cactus one or two blocks behind it lands 25% harder and shoves it that way. The terrain does the rest.
skill.feedback.move.quench.desc: A hot weapon, or a hot gun barrel, on a wet read creature gives off steam: up to 40% more damage by how hot it is, and the weapon cools by 80 Tu. You trade the temper of a hot weapon for the blow.
skill.feedback.move.right_tool.desc: A blow on a read creature lands 30% harder when its class is one the creature is weak to, and Size up names the classes: bone is weak to blunt (a mace, a fist, a blast), a bare thin hide to pierce (a spear, an arrow, a bullet), soft worn cloth or leather to slash (a blade, claws), cold dry air to fire, wet skin to shock. Weakness comes from the creature's state and what it wears, never from its name.
skill.feedback.move.conductor.desc: Shock hurts a read creature 50% more while it is wet or in heavy armour: a shock capsule, a live wire it was driven into.
skill.feedback.move.case_file.desc: Standing knowledge: every kill of a creature type adds 1% to your blows against that type, up to 20%, read or not. Kept on you across deaths.
skill.feedback.move.pattern.desc: After ten kills of a creature type, size up reads it twice as long and shows what it hits for.
skill.feedback.move.herd_read.desc: Size up also reads every creature of the same kind within six blocks of the one you looked at.
skill.feedback.move.read_the_room.desc: Size up on a player also reads their gun in words: empty, one round left, barrel hot.
skill.feedback.move.spoor.desc: Cast: follow the last creature you read, even out of sight, as a trail of light only you can see for twenty seconds. Sixty-four blocks at most. Costs 20 stamina.
slot.feedback.head: head
skill.feedback.move.read_the_draw.desc: Standing sight: a creature drawing a bow or crossbow, or a mob holding a gun with its eyes on someone, glows on your screen within forty-eight blocks while it does, and stops when it does. Only you see it. Needs no read.
skill.feedback.move.quarry_mark.desc: A bow or crossbow hit out at range makes the target glow for as long as the arrow carried energy: a hard draw marks for seconds, a short one barely. Twin of the gun skills. Price: nothing within six blocks, and a dead target is not marked.
skill.feedback.move.far_sight.desc: A hard-drawn arrow flies flat for its first second before it starts to drop, so a long shot needs no lead. Price: only a near-full draw, and it drops after the second.
skill.feedback.move.point_blank_draw.des: A bow or crossbow hit within four blocks staggers the target by the arrow's energy over the target's mass: a hard draw shoves a light body, a heavy one hardly moves. Twin of Muzzle stagger. Price: you have to be on top of them.
skill.feedback.move.barbed_shaft.desc: A close bow or crossbow hit leaves a barb in the target for ten seconds; your next melee blow spends the barbs as damage, up to five. Twin of Marked rounds. Price: you have to get close, and the barbs work loose.
skill.feedback.move.braced_draw.desc: An arrow loosed braced against terrain (crouched against a block, or on a wall) leaves exactly down your sight line with no scatter. Twin of Braced fire. Price: you have to be braced.
skill.feedback.move.snap_shot.desc: After a roll that swallowed a blow, your next arrow leaves at full draw however briefly you drew. Twin of Dodge charge. Price: the roll has to cross a blow, and it fades after three seconds.
skill.feedback.move.quarry_breath.desc: Killing at range with a bow or crossbow gives stamina back by the arrow's energy. Twin of Hot clear. Price: the kill has to be six blocks or more away.
skill.feedback.move.far_end.desc: Blows landing out at the tip of your reach hit harder, more the more head-heavy the weapon. Price: up close you get nothing. Excludes Close work.
skill.feedback.move.close_work.desc: Blows landing inside half your reach recharge the swing faster. Price: at the tip you get nothing. Excludes Far end.
skill.feedback.move.pry_open.desc: A blow landing on a target whose weapon was just beaten (staggered, or guard up) binds that hand; a raised shield is disabled instead. Softer, more worn steel binds longer. Price: only on an opening, and spent until you parry.
skill.feedback.move.wall_smash.desc: A kick that sends a foe into a wall adds the weight of the armor they wear to the stagger. Price: it needs a wall at their back.
skill.feedback.move.wall_rebound.desc: A wall kick keeps its momentum for one more kick off a second wall before you touch ground. Price: it needs a second wall.
skill.feedback.move.breach_kick.desc: A kick on a target already staggered knocks it down; on a steady one it only shoves. Kick what is already broken.
skill.feedback.figure.running_bolt: Open-bolt sustained fire spread and kick %s (fraction off)
skill.feedback.move.forge_cadence.desc: Always on, at the forge: every three clean blows in a row raise your tempo one step (a pip under the beat lights), and each blow struck at a step lands eight percent harder per step, filling what lighter blows left short. A miss drops the tempo to nothing. Clean forging streaks also earn Onslaught points, less for each repeat of the same shape.
skill.feedback.move.forge_steady.desc: Always on, at the forge: a loose blow (close to the beat, not on it) holds your tempo instead of dropping it, once per run. A miss still drops it.
skill.feedback.move.throwback.desc: A parry made with the off hand empty returns the attacker's stagger doubled; the riposte window is your free counter. Price: a free hand, so no shield or dual wield.
skill.feedback.move.slip.desc: A parry on the window's very last tick turns into a step-through: the blow whiffs and you end up behind the attacker. Price: the last tick is the narrow one, and a missed slip is normal recovery.
skill.feedback.move.answer.desc: The first blow after a clean parry is blocked outright. Price: the guard rearms only when you land a blow, so waiting buys nothing.
skill.feedback.move.roll_with_it.desc: A parry on the last tick takes the blow on the weapon's flat: excess force becomes extra stagger on the attacker instead of weapon wear. Price: the late tick.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_heavy_butt.de: A pistol-whip shoves the target half again as hard.
skill.feedback.move.riposte.desc: After a successful parry, your next melee hit within 1.5 s (30 ticks) deals 1.5x damage.
skill.feedback.move.wall_kick.desc: Tap jump in the air, facing a wall, within 1.2 s of sprinting or rolling on the ground, to kick off it, up and back. Costs hunger; resets fall distance.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_pistol_whip.d: In barehanded mode, attacking with a held gun swings it as a bludgeon. Damage and recovery follow the gun's mass.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_chamber.desc: A pistol-whip heavy enough to stagger the target fires a free shot at it. Needs a loaded gun; one stagger, one shot.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_dual.desc: The off-hand gun can pistol-whip too, on its own cooldown.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_spin.desc: Sneak while pistol-whipping to spin: hits every body within 2 blocks, but recovery is 1.5x longer.
skill.feedback.move.blade_flourish.desc: A landed blade hit takes 10 ticks off the roll cooldown (parry and kick wait on it too).
skill.feedback.move.mace_quake.desc: A blow of 5+ damage, from any weapon or a plated fist, shakes the ground: bodies within 2.5 blocks of the target are knocked back and staggered.
skill.feedback.move.spear_vault.desc: A spear thrust landed while sprinting on the ground vaults you up and forward. 2 s cooldown.

tooltip.feedback.potion.drink_ignite: Do not drink. It sets the drinker alight.
tooltip.feedback.potion.drink_explosion: Do not drink. It detonates on the drinker.

feedback.stand.dud: The brew comes out a dud.

gui.feedback.stand.title: Brewing Stand
gui.feedback.stand.hint: Stir in circles over the map. Hover a plant in your inventory or the pot to see the curve it would add.
